description: Hochwasserschutz Frankfurt (Oder) - (WMS-HOCHWASSERSCHUTZ) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are gewässerschutz, hochwasser, infomapaccessservice, opendata, sicherheit. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
